fact: On 4 August 2026 the Sudan Judiciary signed a contract with the National Technical Company, funded by the Ministry of Finance, to implement a digital transformation project covering several systems that run the judiciary's work.
title: توقيع عقد لتنفيذ مشروع التحول الرقمي بين السلطة القضائية والشركة الوطنية التقنية
